sloka: अथवा स्वयमप्येष मोक्षं प्राप्स्यति पार्थिवः।गृहीतो ऽयं यदि भवेत्ऺित्रदशैः सासुरोरगैः ।। ६.६७.७७ ।।
transliteration: athavā svayamapyeṣa mokṣaṁ prāpsyati pārthivaḥ।gṛhīto 'yaṁ yadi bhavetऺitradaśaiḥ sāsuroragaiḥ ।। 6.67.77 ।।

translations.english: 'Mighty Kumbhakarna shattered by my fist in a duel, and the king of Vanaras delivered, all the monkeys will be rejoiced.'
